properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh implements elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman over elliptic@6.5.3 (secp256k1/prime256v1 etc. chosen by curve name argument at call time), pulled in by crypto-browserify@3.12.0 so the browser bundle gets crypto.createECDH — needed by the wallet's browser-side crypto (bitcoin key handling).
